statement: A chat member said Dragon Hunter Idle RPG is a lot like IdleOn and he thinks they may be right
Says the other game is already better than IdleOn because your character fights on its own with Auto on
Says the daily bonus claim in this game is something Lava (IdleOn's developer) should take notes on
Jokes that putting points into physical attack is his IdleOn knowledge and calls it a wrong endgame choice
Says the Infinity Tower in this game is what infinite content should have been
Says smelter upgrades being pay to win is just like IdleOn
Jokes that the other game might be the IdleOn killer
Says the other game has something IdleOn doesn't: jiggle physics
Wishes IdleOn were like the other game at the start with 96 kills per hour
